g.text: 1. C-201 wet vacuum column: 4 packed beds + 4 stripping trays; flash zone 60 mbar(a), top 20 mbar(a).
2. Wash-bed wetting is critical: FIC-2020 minimum-flow alarm and APC constraint (coke prevention).
3. Boot temperature limited to 365 C by cooled VR quench (TIC-2026 cascade to FIC-2027).
4. Draw-off pumps P-201/202/203 and product routing on CFU-200-PR-PID-014.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
ID 4.4 m (top) / 6.6 m (main) / 3.0 m (boot) x 36.0 m T/T
DESIGN FV / 3.5 barg / 415 C; CA 6 mm
4 packed beds (structured 250Y/grid), 4 stripping trays, vapour horn
MAT'L CS + 410S clad (317L clad flash/wash zone)
